the-ring-of-speed.x: The ring of speed is a wearable item that that can go in the ring slot of the player's inventory. It increases the player's [[tool|tool]] use speed by 30%. The effect does stack when wearing two rings.

blessed-opal-ring.x: Blessed opal ring is a wearable item that that can go in the ring slot of the player's inventory. It increases the player's chance of finding rare items.
